prompts.walk: Create a production WALK CYCLE sprite sheet for the SAME original leaf-hat witch shown in the reference. Reference is character identity and painted rendering ONLY, do not copy the existing pose sheet layout. EXACTLY SIX full body figures, arranged in a 3-COLUMN x 2-ROW grid of equal generous cells. All looking RIGHT in three-quarter side view, same brown bob, peach big-eyed face, teal leaf hat with apricot flower, emerald capelet, cream sleeves, teal gold-embroidered leaf tunic, brown satchel and ankle boots, amber-tipped wand held low near waist. Premium painted gouache game sprites, not pixel/vector/3D. Draw six anatomically DIFFERENT WALK phases, moderate steps not running or flying: row1 left CONTACT A near leg FORWARD heel touching floor and far leg BACK toe; row1 middle DOWN A near knee bent forward supporting weight, far leg curling behind up; row1 right PASS A near leg vertical under body, far knee rising FORWARD boot tucked near calf. Row2 left CONTACT B far leg FORWARD heel touching floor near leg BACK toe; row2 middle DOWN B far knee bent supporting weight near foot curled behind; row2 right PASS B far leg straight under body near knee lifted FORWARD. Strong obvious opposite knee/boot overlap on A versus B, not six near-identical split strides. Arms counter-swing and cape subtly follows stride; head identity and size constant. Each whole hat, wand, cape, boots visible, transparent blank space at least 15 percent of cell around every figure, even foot baseline, all six same scale, no labels/numbers, no ground shadow, genuine transparent alpha.

derivations.ground: Central painted earth strip resized and mirrored horizontally for identical tile edge columns.

limitations: Walk has six authored key phases, not additional inbetweens.
Terrain stretch preserves painted image structure; extreme aspect ratios can stretch flowers and rocks.
Forest stage is offline art composition, not browser/runtime evidence.
